season.evidence: Stored Jul-Oct window kept; class 3 scramble on a long off-trail approach from Wolf Creek. Peak-wide ascents run Apr-Oct (Oct 80, Sep 65) but nearly all are the south-side Scatter Creek route, so they say little about the north ridge.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Logged as Abernathy Lake to north ridge, Wolf Creek start, but done 26 April on snow with snowshoes and an ice axe (out of season) and the recorded track begins at Gardner Meadows camp, so it is not a trailhead round trip.

notes: Our catalog holds only the North Ridge (Wolf Creek). All usable Peakbagger tracks, including every summited one, use the Scatter Creek / Scatter Lake south side (standard class 2 route, trailhead near 48.4352,-120.5199, about 3,100 ft), which has no route row on this peak. Consider adding a Standard South/Southeast route; its tracks (summit within 35 m, May-Oct) are ready to attach. Not done here since the brief covers existing routes only.
